prompt: `src/trailhead/plan.py` has no tests. Write `tests/test_plan.py` with pytest tests that check its behaviour as documented in the README and the docstrings. Don't change anything under `src/`.
bash_commands: git ls-files && cat README.md && cat src/trailhead/plan.py && ls tests 2>/dev/null && cat pyproject.toml
cat src/trailhead/pace.py src/trailhead/track.py src/trailhead/elevation.py src/trailhead/report.py tests/conftest.py tests/test_pace.py
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -40; ruff check tests/test_plan.py

W=$TMPDIR/mut && for m in 's/used > 0 and used + hours > max_hours_per_day/used + hours > max_hours_per_day/' 's/first, used = index, 0.0/first, used = index + 1, 0.0/' 's/round(used, 2)))$/round(used, 1)))/' 's/minutes:02d/minutes/' 's/leg_hours(track, fitness)/leg_hours(track)/' 's/if max_hours_per_day <= 0/if max_hours_per_day < 0/'; do rm -rf $W; cp -r . $W; sed -i "$m" $W/src/trailhead/plan.py; (cd $W && python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_plan.py 2>&1 | tail -1 | sed "s|^|$m => |"); done

cat > "$TMPDIR/mut.sh" <<'EOF'
src=$1; w=$2/mut
while IFS= read -r m; do
  rm -rf "$w"; cp -r "$src" "$w"; sed -i "$m" "$w/src/trailhead/plan.py"
  echo "$m => $(cd "$w" && python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_plan.py 2>&1 | tail -1)"
done <<'M'
s/used > 0 and used + hours > max_hours_per_day/used + hours > max_hours_per_day/
s/first, used = index, 0.0/first, used = index + 1, 0.0/
s/round(used, 2)))$/round(used, 1)))/
s/minutes:02d/minutes/
s/leg_hours(track, fitness)/leg_hours(track)/
s/if max_hours_per_day <= 0/if max_hours_per_day < 0/
M
EOF
bash "$TMPDIR/mut.sh" "$PWD" "$TMPDIR"
